mapper.select: SELECT SUMMARY_ID, LISTING_ID, MODEL, PROMPT_VERSION, SUMMARY_TEXT, HIGHLIGHTS, CAUTIONS, INPUT_HASH, INPUT_TOKENS, OUTPUT_TOKENS, STATUS, ERROR_MESSAGE, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT FROM LISTING_AI_SUMMARY WHERE LISTING_ID = #{listingId}

SELECT L.LISTING_ID FROM LISTINGS L LEFT JOIN LISTING_AI_SUMMARY S ON S.LISTING_ID = L.LISTING_ID WHERE L.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND L.DELETED_AT IS NULL AND S.SUMMARY_ID IS NULL ORDER BY L.CREATED_AT DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO LISTING_AI_SUMMARY (LISTING_ID, MODEL, PROMPT_VERSION, SUMMARY_TEXT, HIGHLIGHTS, CAUTIONS, INPUT_HASH, INPUT_TOKENS, OUTPUT_TOKENS, STATUS, ERROR_MESSAGE) VALUES (#{listingId}, #{model}, #{promptVersion}, #{summaryText}, #{highlights}, #{cautions}, #{inputHash}, #{inputTokens}, #{outputTokens}, #{status}, #{errorMessage}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE MODEL = VALUES(MODEL), PROMPT_VERSION = VALUES(PROMPT_VERSION), SUMMARY_TEXT = VALUES(SUMMARY_TEXT), HIGHLIGHTS = VALUES(HIGHLIGHTS), CAUTIONS = VALUES(CAUTIONS), INPUT_HASH = VALUES(INPUT_HASH), INPUT_TOKENS = VALUES(INPUT_TOKENS), OUTPUT_TOKENS = VALUES(OUTPUT_TOKENS), STATUS = VALUES(STATUS), ERROR_MESSAGE = VALUES(ERROR_MESSAGE)
